module: Internal development tool: after a mission starts, it runs the GPU material "baker" (bakeShapeMaterialsPBR) then the glTF export (exportShapeToGltf) on a fixed list of 10 buildings of the west_coast_usa level, to validate the chain end to end. The results (PNG atlas and .gltf file) are written to /temp/bakeTest/<name>/.
notes: Baking at 4096 px with a 16 px gutter. A 60-frame wait follows the mission start to let the shaders compile; one mesh is processed per frame (onUpdate).
A [i/n] log is written for each mesh (OK or FAIL), then a summary "bakeTest DONE: n ok, m failed".
Depends on global engine functions (bakeShapeMaterialsPBR, exportShapeToGltf) and on .dae files of the west_coast_usa level.

onClientPostStartMission.desc: Hook called after a mission starts: arms the processing and starts a 60-frame wait.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: after the wait, processes one mesh per frame (baking then glTF export) until the end of the list.
